status: R-P1.40 PASS but VACUOUS; R-P1.41 S1 upheld 12/12, S2-S4 falsified by a units error
instrument: SimConfig.marker_reliability with its own deterministic stream
finding: identity identifiability is 1 - (1-p)^N with N the total marker opportunities across visible bodies and p the per-opportunity reliability: coverage sets N, reliability sets p, and the two compose in the exponent. One chance per body already gives N=2.
defects: R-P1.40 sat in the saturated regime (N=56), so its four predictions were unfalsifiable as built; recorded as vacuous rather than as evidence

R-P1.41's S2/S3/S4 stated N as slots per body while the measured quantity counts markers across both bodies (2,4,6) - a units error in the prereg, corrected in the card, with S1 (which uses the measured N) as the substantive check
